name: Alexios
source:
Omorfan ambassador to Adastra who became Cassius's personal servant after being stranded on the planet when it became deprived of advanced Parental space travel technology. He claims to have missed the Omorfan retrieval ship after oversleeping and getting caught in traffic.
He is one of the first friends Marco makes on Adastra and the first one to realize that Marco is not what Amicus says he is.

[spoiler] He is secretly in an intimate physical relationship with Cassius, later revealed to be romantic.[/spoiler]
